observed in individuals with T2DM: insulin resistance 
and relative insulin deﬁ ciency. Although insulin re-
sistance develops many years before onset of diabetes 
in individuals with predisposition to T2DM, clinical 
onset is correlated with the diminishing pancreatic 
release of insulin.3
T2DM is typiﬁ ed by peripheral insulin resistance 
with an insulin secretory defect that varies in severity. 
Insulin resistance is caused by a cell-receptor defect
resulting in the body’s inability to use insulin. When 
cells cannot respond to insulin by translocating glucose 
transporters to their outer membrane, they are un-
able to take up glucose from the blood for fuel. Since
